description:
Traffic summary for one website over a date range.

    Returns page views, unique visitors and their change vs the same
    number of days before, top countries, top pages, which AI bots read
    the site (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and others), and the most
    clicked buttons. Use this when the user asks how a site
    is doing. Get the site_id from list_websites first.

    Args:
        site_id: One of the site_ids returned by list_websites.
        start_date: Range start, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive).
        end_date: Range end, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive), at most 90 days
            after start_date.

    Without sign-in only the public demo site works.
name: website_summary

AiReaderCount.description:
Phase 8 T4.8 — an AI company's bots that read the site (bot_visits;
counted by the name each bot gives itself).
AiReaderCount.title: AiReaderCount

ButtonClickCount.description: Phase 8 T4.8 — a button / link people clicked (site_clicks).
ButtonClickCount.title: ButtonClickCount

DateRange.description:
Inclusive start / end date range for a website summary query.

`website_summary()` checks `start <= end` and the 90-day max span (so a
runaway MCP prompt can't scan the whole click_logs history); the model
itself has no validators, so error answers can carry the range as sent.
DateRange.title: DateRange

outputSchema.description:
Return type for `website_summary(site_id, date_range)`.

Page views (`total_visits`), unique visitors + their trend (S6-12),
top countries + top pages, AI readers, top clicks and a narrative
describing the window. `ai_noticed` is reserved for a follow-up.

total_visits.description: Page views: every page opened on the site in the date range.
total_visits.title: Total Visits

trend_pct.description: Change in unique visitors vs the same number of days right before, in percent.
trend_pct.title: Trend Pct

unique_visitors.description: Distinct visitors (browser sessions) in the date range, the Visitors number on lubot.ai.
unique_visitors.title: Unique Visitors

outputSchema.title: WebsiteSummary

title: Website Traffic Summary
